AgainstEffectDef.description:
More damage against a target that has a status effect (RLM-540: Ice Lance against a Frozen target), growing per
rank (RLM-542: Ice Lance's x 2 to x 3).

damage_per_level_percent.description: Added to damage_percent for every spell level above 1.
damage_per_level_percent.title: Damage Per Level Percent

damage_percent.description: How much more damage the hit deals then at spell level 1, in percent: 200 triples it.
damage_percent.title: Damage Percent

effect.description: The status effect the target has, e.g. realmforge:frozen.
effect.title: Effect

AgainstEffectDef.title: AgainstEffectDef

AllyTargetingDef.description:
The caster or one of its allies (for players: other players), in range and in line of sight. Without a
target the spell takes the caster.
AllyTargetingDef.title: AllyTargetingDef

ApplyEffectEffectDef.description:
Gives each target a status effect: a vanilla one (``minecraft:slowness``) until our own come with C3c
(RLM-26). Combat effects keep their own short time scale (research SP-8), so at most 60 seconds.

amplifier.description: Its strength above the first at spell level 1: 0 is Slowness I, 1 is Slowness II.
amplifier.title: Amplifier

duration_per_level_seconds.description: Added to the duration for every spell level above 1 (C4: a rank lasts longer).
duration_per_level_seconds.title: Duration Per Level Seconds

duration_seconds.description: How long it lasts at spell level 1; more than 0, at most 60.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

stronger_at_levels.description: Spell levels (ranks) from which the amplifier is one higher, in ascending order: [5] makes Slowness I Slowness II from rank 5.
stronger_at_levels.title: Stronger At Levels

ApplyEffectEffectDef.title: ApplyEffectEffectDef

AreaEffectDef.description:
Places a ground zone at the target (the caster's feet, an enemy's or a ground point) that runs its own
``effects`` on every enemy (or ally) inside it as it appears and then every interval, once per interval of
``duration_seconds`` (architecture 11.3).

affects.description: Whom its effects act on: the caster's enemies or its allies.
affects.title: Affects

duration_seconds.description: How long it lasts: a whole number of intervals, at most 60 s.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

effects.description: What it does to each entity inside each time it acts, in order.
effects.title: Effects

interval_seconds.description: The time between two runs of its effects; more than 0.
interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds

ring_color.description: The colour of the ring of dust that shows its edge, "#RRGGBB"; without it, a ring of purple sparks (until C6, RLM-29).
ring_color.title: Ring Color

AreaEffectDef.title: AreaEffectDef

BlockCooldownDef.description:
A raised two-handed weapon's cooldown after a block or after lowering it (architecture 9.3), shorter from a rank
on (RLM-541: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization's 0.25 s at rank 3).

from_level.description: The rank from which it applies.
from_level.title: From Level

reduction_seconds.description: How much shorter, in seconds; more than 0, at most 10.
reduction_seconds.title: Reduction Seconds

BlockCooldownDef.title: BlockCooldownDef

CastTimeCastDef.description:
The spell takes ``duration_seconds`` to cast, which Cast Time Reduction shortens. At the end the cost and the
target are checked again; the cost, its own cooldown and the effects follow. The global cooldown starts with the
cast.

animation.description: How a custom mob or boss moves its arms while it casts (its model's animation): raise (the default) lifts them forward and up, the hands before its forehead; slam beats its fists up and down, one slam every 0.75 s, the time a channel of the same interval ticks at (a quake). Players' casts ignore it.
animation.title: Animation

castable_while_moving.description: Whether the caster moves at full speed during the cast; by default the cast halves its speed (moving never cancels it).
castable_while_moving.title: Castable While Moving

duration_seconds.description: The cast time, before Cast Time Reduction; more than 0.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

forms_projectile.description: Whether the spell's projectile forms in front of the caster during the cast, growing to its size, and flies from there; the spell's first effect is a projectile with an appearance.
forms_projectile.title: Forms Projectile

keep_range_percent.description: For this share of the cast, in percent, the target must stay in range, or the cast ends at once; after it, range no longer matters. Left out: range is checked only before the effects.
keep_range_percent.title: Keep Range Percent

keep_sight.description: Whether the caster must keep its target in sight for the whole cast: losing sight of it ends the cast at once.
keep_sight.title: Keep Sight

lock_on.description: Whether the spell keeps its target once cast: the target must still be alive and in the caster's dimension, but range and line of sight are not checked again.
lock_on.title: Lock On

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

sound.description: A sound event the caster makes when the cast begins, e.g. its chant.
sound.title: Sound

CastTimeCastDef.title: CastTimeCastDef

ChannelCastDef.description:
The spell pays its cost and starts its cooldowns when the channel begins, then runs its effects every
``interval_seconds`` for ``duration_seconds``, checking the target before every tick. Cast Time Reduction shortens
the interval, so the channel keeps its number of ticks.

animation.description: How a custom mob or boss moves its arms while it casts (its model's animation): raise (the default) lifts them forward and up, the hands before its forehead; slam beats its fists up and down, one slam every 0.75 s, the time a channel of the same interval ticks at (a quake). Players' casts ignore it.
animation.title: Animation

castable_while_moving.description: Whether the caster moves at full speed during the cast; by default the cast halves its speed (moving never cancels it).
castable_while_moving.title: Castable While Moving

duration_seconds.description: How long the channel lasts, before Cast Time Reduction: a whole number of intervals.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

interval_seconds.description: The time between two ticks of the effects; more than 0.
interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds

keep_range_percent.description: For this share of the cast, in percent, the target must stay in range, or the cast ends at once; after it, range no longer matters. Left out: range is checked only before the effects.
keep_range_percent.title: Keep Range Percent

keep_sight.description: Whether the caster must keep its target in sight for the whole cast: losing sight of it ends the cast at once.
keep_sight.title: Keep Sight

lock_on.description: Whether the spell keeps its target once cast: the target must still be alive and in the caster's dimension, but range and line of sight are not checked again.
lock_on.title: Lock On

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

sound.description: A sound event the caster makes when the cast begins, e.g. its chant.
sound.title: Sound

ChannelCastDef.title: ChannelCastDef

ChargeEffectDef.description:
Rushes the caster at its enemy target (RLM-543: the Arms Warrior's Charge) until it stands in front of it, the
server steering it every tick, then runs ``effects`` on every enemy within ``landing_radius`` of where it lands
(Charge's stun). A charge that cannot get through (a wall) lands where it stopped.

effects.description: What the landing does to each enemy round it, e.g. a stun.
effects.title: Effects

landing_radius.description: The blocks round the landing whose enemies the effects reach, at most 16.
landing_radius.title: Landing Radius

speed.description: How fast the caster rushes, in blocks per second, at most 60.
speed.title: Speed

ChargeEffectDef.title: ChargeEffectDef

CleanseEffectDef.description:
Removes every harmful status effect from each target: debuffs, damage over time and loss of control such as a
stun (the Human's Will To Survive, C4).
CleanseEffectDef.title: CleanseEffectDef

ConeEffectDef.description:
A cone along the caster's look (RLM-542: Cone of Cold): every enemy whose hitbox lies within ``range`` blocks of
the cone's tip (the caster's eyes, lowered as a melee shape's origin) and within half of ``angle_degrees`` of the
look (its middle or its nearest point) takes ``effects``, the same for each; none behind a wall (more than half
hidden from the caster's eyes, as for a melee shape). It follows the look, so the spell needs no target: an empty
cone hits nothing. Its sound plays from the caster, and its particle block's break particles fill it.

angle_degrees.description: How wide it opens, in degrees: 60 is 30 to each side.
angle_degrees.title: Angle Degrees

effects.description: What it does to each enemy inside, in order.
effects.title: Effects

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

particles.description: A block whose break particles fill the cone, e.g. minecraft:packed_ice.
particles.title: Particles

range.description: How far it reaches, in blocks, at most 16.
range.title: Range

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

sound.description: A sound event played from the caster.
sound.title: Sound

ConeEffectDef.title: ConeEffectDef

CostDef.description: What a cast costs: an amount of a resource (mana or rage), growing per spell level like the effects.

extra.description: More of the resource the cast spends when the caster has it, for more damage (RLM-540).

per_level.description: Added for every spell level above 1.
per_level.title: Per Level

refund_on_kill.description: Resource that comes back for each enemy the spell's hits kill, from a rank on (RLM-543: Execute's {amount: 10, from_level: 3}).

CostDef.title: CostDef

CritChanceDef.description:
More crit chance for the player's spell hits on a target with a status effect (RLM-541: Shatter, against Frozen
targets).

against.description: The status effect the target has, e.g. realmforge:frozen.
against.title: Against

chance_per_level_percent.description: Added to chance_percent for every rank above 1.
chance_per_level_percent.title: Chance Per Level Percent

chance_percent.description: The crit chance added at rank 1, in percent.
chance_percent.title: Chance Percent

CritChanceDef.title: CritChanceDef

CritDef.description:
How the spell crits (Matěj, 2026-10-15). By default every spell can crit, on the caster's crit chance, and a
crit deals or heals 1 + the caster's crit damage (150 % with the base 50 %). Talents (postponed, RLM-28) will
change all three.

bonus_chance_per_level_percent.description: Added to bonus_chance_percent for every spell level above 1.
bonus_chance_per_level_percent.title: Bonus Chance Per Level Percent

bonus_chance_percent.description: Crit chance in percent added to the caster's own for this spell, at spell level 1. A chance above 100 % in all turns into crit damage, 1 % for 1 % (C4).
bonus_chance_percent.title: Bonus Chance Percent

can_crit.description: Whether the spell can crit at all.
can_crit.title: Can Crit

multiplier_percent.description: A crit's own multiplier in percent (200 doubles), instead of 1 + the caster's crit damage.
multiplier_percent.title: Multiplier Percent

CritDef.title: CritDef

CurrentTargetTargetingDef.description: NPC only: the caster's current target (the mob's attack target), an enemy in range and in line of sight.
CurrentTargetTargetingDef.title: CurrentTargetTargetingDef

DamageEffectDef.description:
Damage of the spell's school to each target: its amount plus its coefficient of the caster's power (Spell
Power for magic, Attack Damage for a physical ability), then times (1 + the school's power + passives) in the damage
pipeline (architecture 9.1). The hit can crit as the spell's ``crit`` says.

against_effect.description: More damage against a target with a status effect (RLM-540), e.g. {effect: realmforge:frozen, damage_percent: 200} triples it against a Frozen target.

armor_shred_per_level_percent.description: Added to armor_shred_percent for every spell level above 1.
armor_shred_per_level_percent.title: Armor Shred Per Level Percent

armor_shred_percent.description: Armor shred this hit adds to the caster's own, in percent at spell level 1: the share of the target's armor (after armor pierce) the hit ignores. Only a school that armor stops (physical).
armor_shred_percent.title: Armor Shred Percent

attack_damage_per_level_percent.description: Added to attack_damage_percent for every spell level above 1.
attack_damage_per_level_percent.title: Attack Damage Per Level Percent

attack_damage_percent.description: Share of the caster's attack damage added to the amount at spell level 1 (100 adds all of it). Required for the damage of spells that scale with attack_damage, refused for spells that scale with spell_power.
attack_damage_percent.title: Attack Damage Percent

penetration_per_level_percent.description: Added to penetration_percent for every spell level above 1.
penetration_per_level_percent.title: Penetration Per Level Percent

penetration_percent.description: Spell penetration, in percent at spell level 1: the share of the target's resistance to the school the hit ignores. Only a magic school.
penetration_percent.title: Penetration Percent

per_level.description: Added for every spell level above 1.
per_level.title: Per Level

spell_power_per_level_percent.description: Added to spell_power_percent for every spell level above 1.
spell_power_per_level_percent.title: Spell Power Per Level Percent

spell_power_percent.description: Share of the caster's Spell Power (points) added to the amount at spell level 1 (100 adds all of it). Only for spells that scale with spell_power; without it, Spell Power adds nothing.
spell_power_percent.title: Spell Power Percent

DamageEffectDef.title: DamageEffectDef

DamageOverTimeEffectDef.description:
Damage over time kept as the caster's own stack of a status effect with ``stacks`` (RLM-539, Bleeding): the
amount (plus its coefficient of the caster's power) is the damage over the whole duration, fixed from the caster's
stats when it is applied, and its ticks split it evenly. Another spell or caster stacks; the same spell from the
same caster refreshes its stack.

attack_damage_per_level_percent.description: Added to attack_damage_percent for every spell level above 1.
attack_damage_per_level_percent.title: Attack Damage Per Level Percent

attack_damage_percent.description: Share of the caster's attack damage added to the amount at spell level 1 (100 adds all of it). Required for the damage of spells that scale with attack_damage, refused for spells that scale with spell_power.
attack_damage_percent.title: Attack Damage Percent

duration_per_level_seconds.description: Added to the duration for every spell level above 1.
duration_per_level_seconds.title: Duration Per Level Seconds

duration_seconds.description: How long it lasts at spell level 1: a whole number of the effect's intervals, at most 60.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

effect.description: One of our status effects with stacks, e.g. realmforge:bleeding.
effect.title: Effect

per_level.description: Added for every spell level above 1.
per_level.title: Per Level

spell_power_per_level_percent.description: Added to spell_power_percent for every spell level above 1.
spell_power_per_level_percent.title: Spell Power Per Level Percent

spell_power_percent.description: Share of the caster's Spell Power (points) added to the amount at spell level 1 (100 adds all of it). Only for spells that scale with spell_power; without it, Spell Power adds nothing.
spell_power_percent.title: Spell Power Percent

DamageOverTimeEffectDef.title: DamageOverTimeEffectDef

DashEffectDef.description:
Throws the caster toward the target (an enemy, a ground point or along a direction) with a burst of speed,
which friction then slows as for any push.

strength.description: The burst's speed in blocks per tick (1 carries about 2 blocks on the ground), at most 5.
strength.title: Strength

DashEffectDef.title: DashEffectDef

DirectionTargetingDef.description:
A direction from the caster's eyes: toward what the cast aims at, or else where the caster looks, which a
player's crosshair shows and a cast time or a channel follows until its effects run (RLM-344). Its point is
``range`` blocks along it, or the first block in the way (a teleport's destination). It never refuses a cast.
DirectionTargetingDef.title: DirectionTargetingDef

EnemyTargetingDef.description:
A living entity that is not the caster's ally, in range and in line of sight. A melee spell's (``melee:
true``) is instead in the caster's melee swing, Better Combat's sword swing at its melee reach (the default melee
hit shape, Matěj's playtest of 2026-10-31), so it reaches as far as a melee attack.

melee.description: true: the target must be in the caster's melee swing instead; then no range.
melee.title: Melee

EnemyTargetingDef.title: EnemyTargetingDef

ExtraCostDef.description:
More of the resource a cast spends when the caster has it (RLM-540: Execute's extra rage), each point raising
the spell's damage.

damage_per_point_percent.description: How much more damage the spell deals for each point spent, in percent.
damage_per_point_percent.title: Damage Per Point Percent

max.description: The most it spends beyond the cost, e.g. 30 rage.
max.title: Max

ExtraCostDef.title: ExtraCostDef

FarthestPlayerTargetingDef.description:
NPC only: the farthest player in range and in line of sight that the caster may attack, as random_player
chooses from.
FarthestPlayerTargetingDef.title: FarthestPlayerTargetingDef

GainResourceEffectDef.description:
Gives the caster an amount of a resource, growing per rank (RLM-543: Charge generates 15/20 rage). Players only,
as only their casts cost anything.

per_level.description: Added for every spell level above 1.
per_level.title: Per Level

resource.description: The resource the caster gains, e.g. realmforge:rage.
resource.title: Resource

GainResourceEffectDef.title: GainResourceEffectDef

GroundPointTargetingDef.description:
Where a ground spell lands, never refused for range (RLM-346): the block the crosshair hits within range, or
the farthest point in range along the crosshair's line (clamp cast), on the ground below it; aimed at an entity or
a point in range, its feet or the point (in sight). No entity: effects that act on one run through a projectile or
an area.
GroundPointTargetingDef.title: GroundPointTargetingDef

HealEffectDef.description:
Healing of each target: its amount plus its coefficient of the caster's power and its share of the healed
entity's max health, times (1 + the school's power) for a spell that scales with spell power. Heals can crit too
(Matěj, 2026-10-15). With ``on_caster`` it heals the caster instead (RLM-543: Victory Rush strikes an enemy and heals
the Warrior).

attack_damage_per_level_percent.description: Added to attack_damage_percent for every spell level above 1.
attack_damage_per_level_percent.title: Attack Damage Per Level Percent

attack_damage_percent.description: Share of the caster's attack damage added to the amount at spell level 1 (100 adds all of it). Required for the damage of spells that scale with attack_damage, refused for spells that scale with spell_power.
attack_damage_percent.title: Attack Damage Percent

max_health_per_level_percent.description: Added to max_health_percent for every spell level above 1.
max_health_per_level_percent.title: Max Health Per Level Percent

max_health_percent.description: Share of the healed entity's max health added at spell level 1, in percent (Victory Rush's 10).
max_health_percent.title: Max Health Percent

on_caster.description: true: heals the caster instead of the spell's target, once, whatever the spell targets. Only among the spell's own effects, not a projectile's, an area's, a melee shape's, a cone's or a charge's.
on_caster.title: On Caster

per_level.description: Added for every spell level above 1.
per_level.title: Per Level

spell_power_per_level_percent.description: Added to spell_power_percent for every spell level above 1.
spell_power_per_level_percent.title: Spell Power Per Level Percent

spell_power_percent.description: Share of the caster's Spell Power (points) added to the amount at spell level 1 (100 adds all of it). Only for spells that scale with spell_power; without it, Spell Power adds nothing.
spell_power_percent.title: Spell Power Percent

HealEffectDef.title: HealEffectDef

InstantCastDef.description:
The spell's effects run when it is cast; with ``animation_seconds``, it starts at once but plays out over its
animation (RLM-399: a Warrior's swing), and its effects run at its hit moment. The caster may move but not swing a
weapon meanwhile; another spell cuts it, and a stun or death before the hit moment gives half its cost and half its
cooldown back.

animation_seconds.description: How long it plays out (its animation, about 0.5 to 1.5 s); Attack Speed never shortens it.
animation_seconds.title: Animation Seconds

hit_at_percent.description: When its effects run, in percent of the animation (50 by default: the middle of a swing).
hit_at_percent.title: Hit At Percent

InstantCastDef.title: InstantCastDef

KillRefundDef.description:
Resource a player's cast gets back for each enemy its hits kill, from a rank on (RLM-543: Execute refunds 10
rage at rank 3).

from_level.description: The rank from which a kill refunds it.
from_level.title: From Level

KillRefundDef.title: KillRefundDef

KnockbackEffectDef.description:
Pushes each target away along the spell's direction (from the caster, the projectile's flight or the area's
middle) and interrupts its cast, unless that may be cast while moving. Knockback Resistance weakens it. The only
way a spell pushes: its damage never knocks back (architecture 9.1).

strength.description: As vanilla's knockback: a melee hit pushes with 0.4, at most 5.
strength.title: Strength

KnockbackEffectDef.title: KnockbackEffectDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

MeleeEffectDef.description:
A melee spell's hit shape in front of the caster (RLM-399): every enemy whose hitbox it strikes takes
``effects``, the same for each, and none behind a wall: an enemy more than half hidden behind blocks from the
caster's eyes is spared. The shape is one of Better Combat's sword hitboxes at the caster's melee reach (its entity
interaction range: 3, 5 in creative mode), so it grows with the reach (Matěj's playtest of 2026-10-31), and it
follows the caster's look (the crosshair), so it tilts with the pitch. swing: Better Combat's sword swing, twice
the reach wide, reach / 3 tall, reach deep and 120° wide, the default melee hit shape (Slam, Reckless Strike);
stab: its sword stab, reach / 2 wide and tall and as deep (Shield Bash).

effects.description: What it does to each enemy inside, in order.
effects.title: Effects

shape.description: swing: Better Combat's sword swing, the default; stab: its narrower sword stab.
shape.title: Shape

MeleeEffectDef.title: MeleeEffectDef

PassiveDef.description:
What a passive spell does (RLM-541): it is never cast and never on the spell bar; while the player knows it, at
its rank, it gives modifiers, raises named spells' damage, adds crit chance against a condition or shortens a
two-handed block's cooldown, and its procs fire (RLM-540: Frostbite, Taste for Blood, Deep Wounds).

block_cooldown.description: A two-handed block's cooldown, shorter from a rank on.

crit_chance.description: More crit chance for the player's spell hits on a target with a status effect.

modifiers.description: Attribute modifiers it gives, growing per rank.
modifiers.title: Modifiers

procs.description: What fires on the player's hits, crits, kills, effects and ticks (RLM-540): Frostbite, Taste for Blood, Deep Wounds.
procs.title: Procs

spell_damage.description: More damage for named spells, growing per rank.
spell_damage.title: Spell Damage

splash_radius.description: A wider splash for named spells' bolts from a rank on.
splash_radius.title: Splash Radius

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

while_wielding.description: An item tag, e.g. realmforge:two_handed_weapons: the whole passive applies only while the main hand holds an item of it.
while_wielding.title: While Wielding

PassiveDef.title: PassiveDef

PassiveModifierDef.description:
An attribute modifier a passive spell gives (RLM-541), growing per rank: its amount at rank 1 plus ``per_level``
(or ``per_level_percent``, in the amount's unit) for every rank above it.

amount_percent.description: The amount in percent (5 means 5 %, the fraction 0.05).
amount_percent.title: Amount Percent

attribute.description: The attribute it modifies, e.g. realmforge:strength.
attribute.title: Attribute

operation.description: How the amount applies (vanilla's attribute modifier operations).
operation.title: Operation

per_level.description: Added to amount for every rank above 1.
per_level.title: Per Level

per_level_percent.description: Added to amount_percent for every rank above 1.
per_level_percent.title: Per Level Percent

PassiveModifierDef.title: PassiveModifierDef

ProcApplyEffectDef.description: A status effect a proc gives the other entity.

duration_seconds.description: How long it lasts; more than 0, at most 60.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

from_level.description: A longer duration from a rank on, e.g. {level: 3, duration_seconds: 3}.

ProcApplyEffectDef.title: ProcApplyEffectDef

ProcDamageOverTimeDef.description:
A damage over time a hit or crit proc gives the entity hit: a share of the hit's damage, after its reductions, as
the player's own stack of a status effect with stacks (RLM-543: Deep Wounds bleeds for 20/40/60 % of a crit's
damage over 6 s). A new proc refreshes the stack and adds what the old one had left, so every hit's share is
dealt.

damage_per_level_percent.description: Added to damage_percent for every rank above 1.
damage_per_level_percent.title: Damage Per Level Percent

damage_percent.description: The share of the hit's damage dealt over the duration at rank 1, in percent.
damage_percent.title: Damage Percent

duration_seconds.description: How long it lasts: a whole number of the effect's intervals, at most 60.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

effect.description: One of our status effects with stacks, e.g. realmforge:bleeding.
effect.title: Effect

ProcDamageOverTimeDef.title: ProcDamageOverTimeDef

ProcDef.description:
A proc of a passive spell (RLM-540): when its trigger happens, at its chance and outside its internal cooldown
on that target (research SP-15), it does one thing: gives the other entity a status effect, casts a spell at it
at the passive's rank, opens a spell's window, or makes it bleed for a share of the hit (RLM-543). Procs never
trigger procs.

apply_effect.description: Gives the other entity a status effect.

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

cast.description: Casts this spell at the other entity, at the passive's rank (at most its own).
cast.title: Cast

chance_per_level_percent.description: Added to chance_percent for every rank above 1.
chance_per_level_percent.title: Chance Per Level Percent

chance_percent.description: The chance it fires at rank 1, in percent.
chance_percent.title: Chance Percent

cooldown_seconds.description: Its internal cooldown on each target, after it fired; at most 60 s.
cooldown_seconds.title: Cooldown Seconds

damage_over_time.description: A hit or crit proc: makes the entity hit bleed for a share of the hit's damage (RLM-543: Deep Wounds).

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

effect.description: applies_effect, tick: the status effect, e.g. minecraft:slowness.
effect.title: Effect

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

open_window.description: Opens this spell's window for the player, e.g. realmforge:overpower.
open_window.title: Open Window

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

spell.description: tick: only the ticks of this spell's damage over time, e.g. realmforge:rend.
spell.title: Spell

trigger.description: hit, crit, kill, hit_taken: the player's hit, crit or kill, or a hit on the player; applies_effect: the player gives an enemy the status effect `effect`; tick: a tick of the player's damage over time of `effect` (and `spell`) on an enemy.
trigger.title: Trigger

ProcDef.title: ProcDef

ProcDurationFromLevelDef.description: A proc's effect that lasts longer from a rank on (RLM-542: Frostbite's Frozen, 3 s instead of 2 at rank 3).

duration_seconds.description: How long it lasts from that rank; more than 0, at most 60.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

level.description: The rank from which it lasts longer; at least 2.
level.title: Level

ProcDurationFromLevelDef.title: ProcDurationFromLevelDef

ProjectileAppearanceDef.description:
How a projectile looks; without it, a trail of sparks (until C6, RLM-29). Its placeholder texture is
generated at ``textures/entity/spell/<spell>.png`` until real art exists.

color.description: Main colour of its placeholder texture, "#RRGGBB".
color.title: Color

model.description: orb: a small spinning orb of three crossed slabs, the shape of a shulker's bullet.
model.title: Model

ProjectileAppearanceDef.title: ProjectileAppearanceDef

ProjectileEffectDef.description:
Launches a projectile from the caster's eyes toward the target (an enemy, a ground point or along a
direction, where the crosshair points). It flies straight and stops at the first living entity in its way that is
not the caster or its ally: one that can be damaged, hostile or passive, takes its own ``effects``, and one that
cannot (invulnerable) or of ``spares`` stops it untouched. A block or the end of its lifetime ends it without them,
and so does leaving the world: above the build height, beyond where entities move, or in the void (architecture
11.3, RLM-344).

appearance.description: How it looks; without it, a trail of sparks.

effects.description: What it does to the enemy it hits, in order.
effects.title: Effects

impact.description: Its sound and particles where it hits a block or an entity.

lifetime_seconds.description: How long it flies before it fizzles; more than 0, at most 10. Without it, it flies until it hits something or leaves the world.
lifetime_seconds.title: Lifetime Seconds

size.description: Width and height of its hitbox in blocks, at most 4.
size.title: Size

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

spares.description: An entity type tag, e.g. realmforge:stone_creatures: an entity in it stops the projectile but takes none of its effects.
spares.title: Spares

splash.description: A small explosion where it hits an enemy (RLM-399): the enemies round the target take its effects too, its damage at a share.

ProjectileEffectDef.title: ProjectileEffectDef

ProjectileImpactDef.description:
What a projectile does where it hits a block or an entity: a sound and a block's break particles, as a mined
block shatters.

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

particles.description: A block whose break particles burst where it hits, e.g. realmforge:vaultstone.
particles.title: Particles

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

ProjectileImpactDef.title: ProjectileImpactDef

RandomPlayerTargetingDef.description:
NPC only: a random player in range and in line of sight that the caster may attack (not in creative or
spectator mode, not its ally).
RandomPlayerTargetingDef.title: RandomPlayerTargetingDef

RemoveEffectEffectDef.description: Removes a status effect from each target, if it has it.
RemoveEffectEffectDef.title: RemoveEffectEffectDef

SpellDamageDef.description:
More damage for named spells (RLM-541: Improved Frostbolt), added to their hits' (1 + School Power + passives)
layer.

damage_per_level_percent.description: Added to damage_percent for every rank above 1.
damage_per_level_percent.title: Damage Per Level Percent

damage_percent.description: How much more damage at rank 1, in percent.
damage_percent.title: Damage Percent

spells.description: The spells whose hits deal more, e.g. [realmforge:frostbolt].

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

spells.title: Spells

SpellDamageDef.title: SpellDamageDef

SplashDef.description:
A bolt's small explosion where it hits an enemy (RLM-399): every other enemy within ``radius`` of the target
takes the projectile's effects too, its damage at ``damage_percent`` and every other effect at full strength.

damage_percent.description: The share of the damage the enemies round the target take.
damage_percent.title: Damage Percent

radius.description: In blocks from the target's hitbox, at most 4.
radius.title: Radius

SplashDef.title: SplashDef

SplashRadiusDef.description:
A wider splash for named spells' bolts from a rank on (RLM-542: Improved Frostbolt's rank 3 widens Frostbolt's
splash from 1 to 1.5 blocks, Matěj, 2026-10-31).

from_level.description: The rank from which it applies.
from_level.title: From Level

radius.description: Blocks added to the splash's radius.
radius.title: Radius

spells.description: The spells whose projectiles' splash grows, e.g. [realmforge:frostbolt].

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

spells.title: Spells

SplashRadiusDef.title: SplashRadiusDef

TargetDistanceDef.description:
How near and how far the spell's enemy may be, the farthest growing per rank (RLM-543: Charge reaches 3 to 10
blocks, 12 at rank 2), from the caster's eyes to the nearest point of the target's box as a range is. The
targeting's range is the farthest any rank reaches, which aim assistance and the client's pick use.

max.description: The farthest at rank 1, in blocks, at most 128.
max.title: Max

max_per_level.description: Added to max for every rank above 1.
max_per_level.title: Max Per Level

min.description: The nearest the target may be, in blocks.
min.title: Min

TargetDistanceDef.title: TargetDistanceDef

TeleportEffectDef.description:
Moves the caster at once to the target: a ground point, or as far along a direction as its range allows. It
stops short of blocks, and does not move when no free spot is found on the way.
TeleportEffectDef.title: TeleportEffectDef

WindowDef.description:
How long a spell stays usable after what opens its window (RLM-540). The spell bar shows the open window with a
glow and the time left; a cast closes it.

duration_seconds.description: How long the window stays open; more than 0, at most 60.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

opened_by.description: block: the player blocks a hit with a shield or a two-handed weapon; kill: the player kills an enemy that is not gray (its level at least the player's - 3). A passive's proc may open it too.
opened_by.title: Opened By

WindowDef.title: WindowDef

description:
A spell for players or NPCs: its school, what it scales with, its targeting, cast, cost, cooldowns, crit
rules and typed effects, with numbers per spell level up to ``max_level`` (architecture 11.1).

cast.description: How it is cast: {type: instant}, {type: cast_time, duration_seconds: 2} or {type: channel, duration_seconds: 3, interval_seconds: 1}. Required for an active spell; a passive one leaves it out.
cast.title: Cast

castable_while_stunned.description: Whether a stunned caster may cast it, as the Human's Will To Survive breaks a stun; every other spell waits until the stun ends.
castable_while_stunned.title: Castable While Stunned

cooldown_seconds.description: The spell's own cooldown; Cooldown Reduction shortens it.
cooldown_seconds.title: Cooldown Seconds

cost.description: What a cast costs, paid when it begins; a channel pays it again as each later second begins. Leave out for a free spell.

crit.description: How the spell crits; every spell can by default.

description.description: What the spell does, in its tooltip: one or two sentences. Numbers come from data through placeholders: {damage}, {heal}, {duration}, {periodic}, {periodic_total}, {interval} and {radius}.

effects.description: What the spell does, in order. Required for an active spell; a passive one leaves it out.
effects.title: Effects

global_cooldown_seconds.description: How long a cast blocks every other spell (0.5 s by default, as in WoW). Every spell is on the global cooldown.
global_cooldown_seconds.title: Global Cooldown Seconds

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

name.description: The spell's name, on the spell bar, in the spellbook and on the cast bar.

npc_only.description: For mob and boss spells that no player may cast.
npc_only.title: Npc Only

passive.description: Makes the spell passive (RLM-541): learned with ranks, never cast and never on the spell bar, it does this while the player knows it. A passive spell names no targeting, cast, cost, cooldowns, crit, effects or scales_with.

requires.description: What a player needs in hand to cast it (RLM-499): melee_weapon (an item of realmforge:melee_weapons in the main hand) or shield (a shield in either hand). A player's physical spell that deals damage in melee names one. Mobs and bosses cast without it.
requires.title: Requires

scales_with.description: spell_power for magic schools, attack_damage for physical abilities (Matěj, 2026-10-15). Required for an active spell; a passive one leaves it out.
scales_with.title: Scales With

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

school.description: The spell school whose damage it deals, e.g. realmforge:fire. A spell that neither deals damage nor heals may leave it out: it belongs to no school (Will To Survive, Matěj, 2026-10-30), and the spell bar frames it in black.
school.title: School

target_distance.description: Castable only on an enemy this near or far, the farthest growing per rank (RLM-543: Charge's {min: 3, max: 10, max_per_level: 2}); the targeting's range is the farthest at max_level.

target_health_below_percent.description: Castable only on a target below this share of its health, in percent (RLM-540: Execute's 20).
target_health_below_percent.title: Target Health Below Percent

targeting.description: Who the spell can target. Required for an active spell; a passive one leaves it out.
targeting.title: Targeting

window.description: Makes the spell usable only for a while after something happens (RLM-540): Overpower after a block, Victory Rush after a kill. A cast closes the window.

title: SpellDef
